title: Sharp two-sided bounds for the product of modified Bessel functions and for its logarithmic derivative
summary: We prove that, for all $x > 0$, the product of modified Bessel functions satisfies \[ \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x^2+ν^2+1/5}} -1$ and the upper bound for $ν\ge 1/2$, and that the sum of the logarithmic derivatives satisfies \[ -\frac{x}{x^2+ν^2-1} -1$ and the lower bound for $ν\ge 1$. All four constants are best possible. The four proofs share the same elementary structure: in each case the relevant auxiliary function satisfies a second-order differential inequality, and the inequality follows from the strong maximum principle.
